text.アールデコなどの上質なアンティーク家具の映える、モダンで質感高いマンションリフォ: A modern apartment renovation of real texture, where fine Art Deco antiques are shown at their best. The building is a well-ventilated vintage block on the high ground of Yokohama Yamate, originally built for foreign residents. The interior, previously a safe beige, has been rebuilt around natural materials — lime plaster walls, wool carpet, solid timber flooring — in a dark-keyed, understated design that sets the antiques off.
text.熟練職人が滑らかでいて、味のある風合いに仕上げています。風通しの良い立地もあり、: Laid by a skilled plasterer, smooth and full of character. Helped by the airy position of the building, the rooms stay comfortable and low in humidity even in summer.
text.白と黒の細かなチェッカーのカーペットはウール100％。土足でも可能なほど耐久性が: A fine black-and-white chequer carpet in 100% wool. It is hard-wearing enough for shoes, it can be used over underfloor heating, and — as only wool does — it resists a spill soaking in.
text.公園に面する窓にはウッドシャッターを設置し、外からの視線を遮りつつ緑を部屋に取り: Wooden shutters at the windows facing the park keep the room from being overlooked while still bringing the greenery in. They admit the view, the light and the air, and carry something of the reassurance of a storm shutter, which makes for a notably private bedroom.
text.ベッドルームに採用した紙クロスは、伝統的な絵柄と18世紀から受け継がれるペイント: The paper wallcovering in the bedroom is made sheet by sheet, in a traditional pattern, using painting techniques carried down from the eighteenth century. The finest natural pigments, no smell, a smooth finish.
